name: RustWeek 2027
description: Week-long Rust event: talks, workshops, hackathon, unconference, All Hands
note: Conference + workshops + hackathon, English; CFP closes 2027-01-10; no early-bird stated
details: Organised by RustNL; welcomes over 950 attendees. Workshops May 24 (Beatrixgebouw, 9:30-17:00), two conference days May 25-26 at Kinepolis (8:30-19:00, about 25 talks per day in three tracks), hackathon at DUS, then the invitation-only Rust Project All Hands and Unconference. Tickets: students 35 EUR, privately paid 199 EUR, employer-paid 749 EUR; workshop add-on 99 EUR (individual) or 349 EUR (employer). Street addresses not on the page.
